name: kai_search_context
title: Search Context
description: Search KaizenOS merchants, contacts, deals, projects, tasks, invoices, activity, evidence sources, and canonical documents including Teams transcripts.
inputDescription: Search input such as query and optional limit.

name: kai_get_record_context
title: Get Record Context
description: Fetch a bounded context pack for one merchant, contact, deal, project, task, invoice, activity, or decision. Includes linked canonical documents and Teams transcripts plus relationship intelligence: merchant warm paths and resurrection status, contact relationship strength and keep-in-touch cadence, contact-linked deals and projects, and deal referral attribution and relationship risk.
inputDescription: Record locator such as entityType and entityId.

name: kai_get_priorities
title: Get Priorities
description: Read the canonical action queue that powers the command center, notifications, and agent priorities, including relationship-decay and keep-in-touch signals.
inputDescription: Optional limit or filtering context.

name: kai_create_merchant
title: Create Merchant
description: Create a merchant/account with row-level provenance.
inputDescription: Merchant fields such as name, posPlatform, ecommercePlatform, websiteUrl, lifecycle status, owner, GMV range, and notes.

name: kai_update_merchant
title: Update Merchant
description: Update an existing canonical merchant with audited row-level provenance.
inputDescription: Merchant id plus editable fields including posPlatform, ecommercePlatform, and websiteUrl. Explicit null clears nullable fields.

name: kai_create_partner
title: Create Partner
description: Create a partner as a role-specific profile on a canonical Merchant organization.
inputDescription: Merchant fields plus partnerType, programName, relationshipStatus, partnerTier, referralDirection, accountOwnerId, regions, specialties, ecosystems, externalPartnerId, partnerSince, agreementStatus, and partnerNotes. relationshipOwnerId remains accepted as a compatibility alias for accountOwnerId.

name: kai_update_partner
title: Update Partner
description: Update canonical Merchant fields and partner-specific relationship data together.
inputDescription: Partner or merchant id plus Merchant or partner-profile fields. Explicit null clears nullable fields.

name: kai_create_contact
title: Create Contact
description: Create a CRM contact, optionally creating or linking a merchant.
inputDescription: Contact fields and optional merchant object or link.

name: kai_update_contact
title: Update Contact
description: Update an existing contact while preserving canonical merchant relationships.
inputDescription: Contact id plus editable contact fields. Explicit null clears nullable fields.

name: kai_create_deal
title: Create Deal
description: Create a deal with a canonical buyer merchant/contact and an optional upstream referral partner/referrer relationship.
inputDescription: Deal fields plus optional merchant/contact, referralPartnerMerchantId, referrerContactId, referralType, engagementModel, scopeSource, scopeApprovalStatus, and evidence. Proposal and SOW lifecycle fields are derived from Deal Desk evidence.

name: kai_update_deal
title: Update Deal
description: Update Deal fields and its upstream referral relationship through the same operating contract used by the app.
inputDescription: Deal id plus editable fields including engagementModel, scopeSource, scopeApprovalStatus, referralPartnerMerchantId, referrerContactId, referralType, painSignal, closePlanStatus, decisionCriteria, implementationRisk, outcomeReason, and outcomeComment. Proposal and SOW lifecycle fields are derived from Deal Desk evidence. Set referralPartnerMerchantId to null to clear the upstream referral link.

name: kai_move_deal_stage
title: Move Deal Stage
description: Move a deal through the canonical engagement, scope, Proposal, and SOW stage-gate contract with provenance and audit.
inputDescription: Deal id and target stage. Closed Won or Lost requires outcomeReason; Other also requires outcomeComment.

name: kai_create_project
title: Create Project
description: Create a project or convert/link one from a deal while preserving source_deal_id and enforcing implementation scope gates.
inputDescription: Project fields plus sourceDealId or dealId, merchant, and evidence. Implementation requires an accepted SOW and approved scope source on the source deal.

name: kai_activate_deal_engagement
title: Activate Deal Engagement
description: Preview or atomically activate an accepted Deal Desk quote into its linked delivery project, milestone and task plan, deposit draft, and remaining phase billing.
inputDescription: dealId, projectName, templateId, projectType, kickoffDate, targetGoLive, optional projectManagerId, and the reviewed milestones/tasks plan. Use dryRun first; confirmation must echo expectedQuoteId, expectedQuoteContentRevision, expectedAcceptanceId when present, expectedCommercialFingerprint, and expectedScheduleIds exactly as previewed so changed commercial terms or payment rows cannot be activated.

name: kai_send_quote_for_acceptance
title: Send Quote for Acceptance
description: Preview or mint a revision-bound client portal link for a generated proposal, SOW, or change order. This sends no email and cannot accept on the client's behalf.
inputDescription: quoteId, documentKind (proposal, sow, or change_order), and documentFingerprint (the SHA-256 of the exact rendered HTML). Use dryRun first to review the document revision and payment schedule.

name: kai_update_project
title: Update Project
description: Update project fields with row-level provenance.
inputDescription: Project id plus the fields to update.

name: kai_move_project_status
title: Move Project Status
description: Move a project status with row-level provenance.
inputDescription: Project id and target status.

name: kai_create_task
title: Create Task
description: Create a project child task with assignee, due date, acceptance criteria, and dependency links.
inputDescription: Task fields plus required projectId or project, optional dependencies, and evidence.

name: kai_update_task
title: Update Task
description: Update a task, including dependency links.
inputDescription: Task id plus fields or dependencies to update.

name: kai_create_project_milestone
title: Create Project Milestone
description: Create a persisted milestone in a project's canonical delivery plan.
inputDescription: Project id, title, phase, date, position, required state, and client visibility.

name: kai_update_project_milestone
title: Update Project Milestone
description: Update milestone timing, phase, status, requirement, or client visibility.
inputDescription: Milestone id plus the fields to update.

name: kai_delete_project_milestone
title: Delete Project Milestone
description: Delete a milestone from an active project's canonical delivery plan.
inputDescription: Milestone id.

name: kai_log_activity
title: Log Activity
description: Append CRM activity to a merchant, contact, deal, project, task, or invoice.
inputDescription: Activity link fields, action, title, body, and visibility.

name: kai_attach_source
title: Attach Source
description: Attach a SharePoint, OneDrive, URL, MCP, or export evidence link to a CRM or project record.
inputDescription: entityType, entityId, sourceType, title, url, externalId, summary, and confidence.

name: kai_link_document
title: Link Existing Document
description: Reuse a canonical SharePoint or OneDrive document on a Deal without uploading it again.
inputDescription: documentId or sourceSystem plus externalId, dealId, and designation: related, scope_basis (the scope source), or sow. Classification does not approve scope or change SOW status.

name: kai_create_client_request
title: Create Client Request
description: Create a client-visible approval or structured project request (document, information, choice, credential, acknowledgement). Credential asks never capture secrets.
inputDescription: requestType (approval | document | information | choice | credential | acknowledgement | file_request), projectId, title, body or instructions, dueDate, clientVisible, and options (required for choice, 2+ labels).

name: kai_list_client_update_drafts
title: List Client Update Drafts
description: List client-update drafts awaiting operator review, optionally scoped to one project or status.
inputDescription: Optional projectId, status (draft, approved, sent, skipped; default draft), and limit (max 50).

name: kai_draft_client_update
title: Draft Client Update
description: Create or revise the content of a draft client update. Never approves, queues, or sends; the operator reviews and sends from the app.
inputDescription: updateId to revise an existing draft, or projectId with periodStart (and optional periodEnd, default one week) to create one. Content fields: subject, editedBody, recipientEmails.

name: kai_invoice_status
title: Invoice Status
description: Read invoice totals, payment rows, and invoice evidence sources.
inputDescription: invoiceId or invoiceNumber.

name: kai_create_expense
title: Create Expense
description: Record a finance-gated project or merchant expense with cost, rebilling terms, receipt linkage, and agent provenance.
inputDescription: projectId or merchantId, description, category, amount, optional taxAmount, currency, incurredOn, vendor, billable, markupPercent, receiptDocumentId, and note. Supports dryRun.

name: kai_update_expense
title: Update Expense
description: Update an unbilled expense while preserving its finance audit trail and provenance.
inputDescription: expense id plus editable expense fields. Supports dryRun.

name: kai_bill_expenses_to_invoice
title: Bill Expenses To Invoice
description: Idempotently add selected unbilled project expenses to a Draft invoice at their client-facing rebill amounts.
inputDescription: invoiceId and expenseIds. Use dryRun to review the invoice, expense descriptions, and rebill amounts before mutation.

name: kai_set_project_margin_baseline
title: Set Project Margin Baseline
description: Set the finance-reviewed opening delivery-cost budget and margin thresholds for a legacy or direct project. Accepted-quote baselines remain immutable.
inputDescription: projectId, plannedCost, targetMarginPercent, and optional marginFloorPercent. Use dryRun to review the project and thresholds before mutation.

name: kai_queue_invoice_reminder
title: Queue Invoice Reminder
description: Queue invoice reminder notifications through the approval-gated automation.
inputDescription: Optional invoiceId to queue one overdue invoice; omit it to run the scheduled bulk reminder queue.

name: kai_trigger_outlook_sync
title: Trigger Microsoft 365 Sync
description: Trigger Microsoft 365 activity, Teams transcript capture, and optional SharePoint or OneDrive document capture.
inputDescription: Sync scope such as days, users, email, meetings, documents, documentDriveIds, documentSiteIds, documentSiteSearch, documentUsers, maxMailboxes, topMessages, topEvents, maxDocumentDepth, or maxDocumentItems.

name: kai_send_intake_request
title: Send Discovery Questionnaire
description: Create a private discovery questionnaire link for a merchant, optionally scoped to a deal. Returns the link secret once; it is never recoverable afterwards. Preview with dryRun first; commit requires a top-level idempotencyKey so retries never mint a second request or email.
inputDescription: merchantId (required); optional dealId, modules (core, pos, ecommerce, migration, integration, b2b, hardware), sentToEmail, expiresAt, and sendEmail. sendEmail=true requires a valid recipient email. Commit requires top-level idempotencyKey.

name: kai_get_intake_answers
title: Read Discovery Answers
description: Read submitted discovery questionnaire answers for a merchant or a single request. Applying answers to records stays a human action in the Review Queue.
inputDescription: intakeRequestId or merchantId.
